name: Linocut
doc: White gouges along the forms, more and wider where light; solid lands in the dark; burnished mottle.

p.f:
L = stretch(blur(lum(I), 1.0))
gouge = maximum(g1, 0.9*g2)
cut = (gouge*(0.4+1.6*L) > 0.55-0.2*L) | (L > 0.86)
inked = ndi.binary_opening(~cut, iterations=1)
mottle = clip(0.93+0.07*n0, 0.75, 1.0)
cov = gaussian(inked.astype(float), 0.5)*mottle
out = array([0.95, 0.93, 0.87])*(1-cov[..., None]) + array([0.09, 0.08, 0.08])*cov[..., None]
